question: What is the name of the newly discovered dragonfly species identified in Kerala in February 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lyriothemis keralensis.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **A new species of dragonfly discovered in Kerala has been named Lyriothemis keralensis.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The species was discovered in Varapetty near Kothamangalam in Ernakulam district, Kerala.**
 
• It had been misidentified since 2013 as Lyriothemis acigastra.
 
• The species is seasonally visible during the Southwest monsoon from May to August.
 
• It was identified through detailed microscopic examination and comparison with museum specimens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Odonatology__

 __
 
• The scientific study of dragonflies and damselflies.
 
• Helps in understanding biodiversity and ecosystem health.
 
 
 
• Sexual Dimorphism__
 __
 
• Refers to visible differences between males and females of a species.
 
• In this species, males are bright red while females are yellow with black markings.
 
 
 
• Southwest Monsoon__
 __
 
• A seasonal wind system bringing heavy rainfall to Kerala from June to September.
 
• Plays a crucial role in sustaining aquatic habitats.
 
 
 
• Biodiversity Conservation__
 
 
• Focuses on protecting species and habitats outside protected areas.
 
• Emphasizes sustainable land-use practices in plantation landscapes.
